findings.evidence: Mathlib defines membership in `integrableExpSet` through integrability (`IntegrableExpMul.lean:112–116`), and provides `integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure` (`Function/L1Space/Integrable.lean:142–144`); thus `interior_subset hμ` at parameter zero proves finiteness of μ.
findings.fix: Remove `[IsFiniteMeasure μ]` from both signatures and derive a local instance from `integrable_of_mem_integrableExpSet (interior_subset hμ)`, simplified at zero, together with `integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure`. Keep `[IsFiniteMeasure ν]`, which is not forced in the zero-measure case.
findings.issue: `[IsFiniteMeasure μ]` is unnecessarily required by both `charFun_eq_of_mgf_eq` (line 91) and `Measure.ext_of_mgf` (line 113): `hμ` already makes the constant-one function integrable and hence μ finite.

summary: Both new determinacy declarations impose a redundant finiteness assumption on μ; their exponential-integrability hypothesis already implies it.
